data.title: 卡提希娅 · 雨廊下的躲雨与烤面包
data.description: 小镇面包房檐下躲雨，店主认出她塞来刚出炉的面包；她抱着温热的纸袋小口啃着，光环也挡不住那股普通的、属于小镇女孩的幸福。
data.action: 小镇面包房檐下躲雨，店主认出她塞来刚出炉的面包
data.promptProse: Cartethyia shelters under the town bakery's eaves, accepting fresh bread from the owner and nibbling it from the warm paper bag. Her pale-blue ankle-length dress and cream cardigan remain simple beneath the halo and blonde braid. The medium view includes the doorway and rain beyond the shelter. Bakery light warms her pleased face and bag creases, with amber reflections on the wet threshold and cooler street surfaces farther away.
